title: SUMPRODUCT reads direct text as 0 and rejects omitted args, unions, and single blank refs with #VALUE!; PRODUCT/SUMSQ/SUMPRODUCT flush subnormals to +0
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527.20088, SUMPRODUCT evaluates direct scalar text to 0 (SUMPRODUCT("3") = 0) and returns #VALUE! for an omitted argument (SUMPRODUCT(A1:A2,) = #VALUE!), a multi-area union (SUMPRODUCT((A1,A7)) = #VALUE!), or a single blank cell reference (while multi-cell ranges read blanks as 0). By contrast, PRODUCT skips omitted arguments (PRODUCT(2,) = 2) and returns #VALUE! for non-numeric direct text (PRODUCT("a")). All three functions flush subnormal products or squares to +0 (PRODUCT(1E-200,1E-200) = 0, SUMSQ(1E-200) = 0, SUMPRODUCT(1E-200,1E-200) = 0).
basis: Measured in Excel 16.0.20527.20088 in cfunc_m3_4 (argument_classes rows 6-37) and matched across 2,887/2,887 SUMPRODUCT, 1,211/1,211 PRODUCT, and 1,211/1,211 SUMSQ full-bank rows (dc-bd5, dc-ymjf.2.6).
